# import 
```{r}
# Data core
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
# Modeling / mediation
library(mediation)     # classic mediation
library(dplyr)

```

# Read data
```{r}
DATA_DIR <- "/Users/mlin2/Desktop/RabLab/tasks/concurrent/data/cleaned_dat/"
RESULT_DIR <- "/Users/mlin2/Desktop/RabLab/tasks/concurrent/data/result_table/"
mergedat <- read_csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "merged_baseline_wDemo.csv"))
mergedat <- mergedat %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(ptau217),
    !is.na(desikan_suvr),
    !is.na(centiloid_wcbl),
    dx %in% c("EOAD","EOnonAD")
  )  %>%
  mutate(log_ptau217 = log(ptau217),
    amy_z = as.numeric(scale(centiloid_wcbl)),
    ptau_z = as.numeric(scale(ptau217)),
    tau_z = as.numeric(scale(desikan_suvr)),
    log_ptau_z = as.numeric(scale(log_ptau217))
  )   

df_base_eoad <- mergedat %>% filter(dx == "EOAD")
df_base_ci   <- mergedat %>% filter(dx %in% c("EOAD", "EOnonAD"))
covars <- c("age_at_ptau", "sex", "years_education")
mergedat %>% count(dx)
```
# modeling 
## NO COVARIATES — log ptau
```{r}
med_model <- lm(log_ptau_z ~ amy_z, data = df_base_eoad)
out_model <- lm(tau_z ~ amy_z + log_ptau_z, data = df_base_eoad)

med <- mediate(
  med_model,
  out_model,
  treat = "amy_z",
  mediator = "log_ptau_z",
  boot = TRUE,
  sims = 1000
)

print("log ptau")
summary(med) 
med_log <- med        
```

## NO COVARIATES — ptau
```{r}
med_model <- lm(ptau_z ~ amy_z, data = df_base_eoad)
out_model <- lm(tau_z ~ amy_z + ptau_z, data = df_base_eoad)

med <- mediate(
  med_model,
  out_model,
  treat = "amy_z",
  mediator = "ptau_z",
  boot = TRUE,
  sims = 1000
)

print("ptau")
summary(med)
med_ptau <- med        
```

## WITH COVARIATES — log ptau
``` {R}
med_model <- lm(log_ptau_z ~ amy_z + age_at_ptau + sex + years_education, data = df_base_eoad)
out_model <- lm(tau_z ~ amy_z + log_ptau_z + age_at_ptau + sex + years_education, data = df_base_eoad)

med <- mediate(
  med_model,
  out_model,
  treat = "amy_z",
  mediator = "log_ptau_z",
  boot = TRUE,
  sims = 1000
)

print("log ptau (cov)")
summary(med)
med_log_cov <- med     
```

## WITH COVARIATES — ptau
``` {R}
med_model <- lm(ptau_z ~ amy_z + age_at_ptau + sex + years_education, data = df_base_eoad)
out_model <- lm(tau_z ~ amy_z + ptau_z + age_at_ptau + sex + years_education, data = df_base_eoad)

med <- mediate(
  med_model,
  out_model,
  treat = "amy_z",
  mediator = "ptau_z",
  boot = TRUE,
  sims = 1000
)

print("ptau (cov)")
summary(med)
med_ptau_cov <- med   
```

``` {R}
fmt <- function(est, low, high) {
  paste0(
    signif(est, 3), " (",
    signif(low, 3), ", ",
    signif(high, 3), ")"
  )
}

extract_row <- function(med_obj, label, cov) {
  data.frame(
    ptau_version = label,
    covariates = cov,
    
    ACME = fmt(med_obj$d0, med_obj$d0.ci[1], med_obj$d0.ci[2]),
    ADE  = fmt(med_obj$z0, med_obj$z0.ci[1], med_obj$z0.ci[2]),
    Total = fmt(med_obj$tau.coef, med_obj$tau.ci[1], med_obj$tau.ci[2]),
    Prop_Mediated = fmt(med_obj$n0, med_obj$n0.ci[1], med_obj$n0.ci[2]),
    
    p_ACME = signif(med_obj$d0.p, 3),
    p_ADE  = signif(med_obj$z0.p, 3),
    p_Total = signif(med_obj$tau.p, 3),
    p_Prop = signif(med_obj$n0.p, 3)
  )
}

results_table <- rbind(
  extract_row(med_log, "log_ptau", "No"),
  extract_row(med_ptau, "ptau", "No"),
  extract_row(med_log_cov, "log_ptau", "Yes"),
  extract_row(med_ptau_cov, "ptau", "Yes")
)

results_table
readr::write_csv(results_table,file = file.path(RESULT_DIR,"mediation_wCov.csv"))
```


# report (not necessary. coefficient check)
```{r}
a <- coef(med_model)["amy_z"]
b <- coef(out_model)["ptau_z"]
c_prime <- coef(out_model)["amy_z"]

# total effect (separate model)
total_model <- lm(tau_z ~ amy_z, data = df_base_eoad)
c_total <- coef(total_model)["amy_z"]

indirect <- a * b
prop_mediated <- indirect / c_total
data.frame(
  path = c("a (X→M)", "b (M→Y)", "c' (X→Y;direct)", "c (total)", "c-c' (indirect)", "prop_mediated ((c-c')/c"),
  estimate = c(a, b, c_prime, c_total, indirect, prop_mediated)
)
```
